claim_boundary: This binding covers SkillGuard self-maintenance through one enforced declared-check workflow, including target-owned public surface adequacy diagnostics. Publication, installation, and release claims still require their own listed checks inside that same workflow.

depth_profile.claim_boundary: SkillGuard freezes and reconciles the target skill's own declared checks. The target skill alone owns domain purpose, failure classes, oracles, fixtures, and depth meaning.
